Yogi Adityanath Criticizes Opposition Over Ram Temple Donations

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has sharply criticized opposition parties, including the Congress and Samajwadi Party, regarding the Ram Temple donation row. He questioned their "newfound" faith and accused them of hypocrisy and past actions against devotees. The controversy also involves allegations of fund mismanagement and criticism of the BJP's Hindutva by figures like Swami Avimukteshwaranand.
